title: Plugin eval task suite: Stryker in the sandbox, final-message-judgeable assertions, pinned model
description: From the second plugin-eval task run (2026-09-26, /tmp/test-skills-plugin-eval/20260926-172405): Stryker cannot open its TCP logging server inside the eval sandbox (EPERM listen), so ts-audit could not measure mutation in either arm; several assertions reference grader-only objective metrics that plugin eval's final-message LLM graders cannot see; the agent model was not pinned (runs were ~$1 and 2-7 min vs 10-30 min on Opus in the skill-creator benchmark).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Stryker runs inside a plugin eval sandbox run for ts-audit (verified by a probe)
Plugin-eval graders for assertions that cite objective metrics are judgeable from the final message or checked by a non-LLM grader
run_plugin_eval.sh pins the agent model (default claude-opus-5-5, overridable)

finalSummary:
Stryker: evals/sandbox_patch_stryker.cjs, applied by the ts-audit scaffold to the run's own node_modules, turns Stryker's TCP log server into a no-op. The eval sandbox denies every listen(), TCP and Unix, as a probe confirmed. Inside a real eval run: 77 mutants, 75 killed, 57 multi-killer, the same as outside.

Graders: make_cases.py maps assertions that cite grader-held evidence to report-claim checks. 'Did not modify' and the hidden-tests assertions are objective-only, and a guard rejects unmapped ones. The runner passes --keep-temp, and evals/grade_plugin_eval.py then runs grade.py on each kept workspace (unsealing sealed/ first). Verified on a probe.

Model: pinned with --model (EVAL_MODEL, default claude-opus-5-5).

The runbook is updated. Delivered in the PR that closes this task.
